sentences.text:
Since the issue involved in the present petition is identical to the Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch cases, this Court by following the decision of this Court in the aforementioned criminal petition and batch, and for the reasons  2 recorded therein, allow the Criminal Petition by quashing the proceedings in C.C No.690 of 2019, on the file of I Additional Junior Civil Judge, Narasaraopet, Guntur District, against the petitioner /A.1.
6.
Registry shall enclose a copy of the common order, dated 27.08.2018 in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch.

As a sequel thereto, the miscellaneous petitions, if any,
pending in this case shall stand closed.
